blurb: Whisk’R Fish’N offers guided fishing trips on Lake Tawakoni and Lake Fork targeting trophy-sized catfish, eater catfish, sandbass, crappie, striper, and hybrid fish. They provide all necessary fishing equipment and have a high success rate with a catch guarantee on trophy and eater trips. The service is suitable for anglers of all experience levels.
